title: Universal critical variables and phase-transition gravity on fresh MaNGA systems
hypothesis: One universal critical variable and transition law, evaluated from baryonic acceleration, density, potential, environment, organization, and response-blind history proxies, predicts a phase-dependent weak-field stellar dynamical response beyond calibrated baryonic gravity, structural controls, a flexible ordinary regression, and a matched response-blind change-point model.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged critical operator and universal parameter set to beat all ordinary baselines across held-out galaxies and broad halves while satisfying positivity, local, material, phase-span, stability-proxy, and later lensing/conservation gates.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Retain a reproducible held-out critical boundary or hysteresis-like association beyond the matched ordinary change-point control even if no complete gravity theory follows.

theory_sources.boundary: Known empirical radial-acceleration scale and MOND-like transition control; an integrated stellar-dispersion fit cannot rediscover or establish MOND.
Known symmetron density-dependent symmetry restoration and fifth-force screening; this experiment is a bounded observable projection, not the field theory.
Known-family combination motivated by dynamical screening and metastability; cross-sectional spectral clocks do not measure causal hysteresis.

Potentially new galaxy-scale synthesis of a Landau fixed-point order parameter with baryonic organization; Landau descriptions of gravitational scalarization are known and historical novelty is not claimed.
Known phase-transition interpretation of spontaneous scalarization in compact objects; the galaxy proxy is not that strong-field mechanism.

independence.rule: Exclude every Item 30, Item 31, and Item 32 exploration or confirmation role before SNR cuts, medians, roles, folds, response queries, or formula evaluation.

sample.stratification: median internal baryonic acceleration crossed with median GEMA five-Mpc baryonic tidal strength after all predecessor and SNR exclusions; 45 selected per cell with five sealed confirmations

physics.dynamical_baseline: Sersic virial stellar-baryon proxy with one training-fitted shared mass scale
physics.stability_scope: finite positive bounded monotone observable projection and converged Landau fixed point only; no covariant Hamiltonian or perturbation stability is established

candidate_generator.algorithm: PCG64 permutation of an exact mixed-radix grammar with 65536 raw cells in each of four critical-transition niches

niches.operator: low-side or high-side universal acceleration critical crossover with external-field coupling
density critical surface shifted by baryonic potential
environment critical surface shifted by acceleration and spectral-clock state
bounded Landau mean-field fixed point sourced by surface density, shape, and spectral-clock organization

equivalence_boundaries: Acceleration crossovers overlap MOND-like interpolation and known empirical acceleration-scale behavior.
Density symmetry breaking is a proxy for known symmetron/chameleon-like screening, not a new field theory.
History/environment hysteresis is cross-sectional and cannot prove a causal loop or metastable branch.
Landau order parameters and gravitational scalarization phase transitions are known; only the frozen galaxy-scale baryonic-organization synthesis may be new, and novelty is unresolved.
Raw parameter cells are not independent laws; behavioral equivalence classes are counted separately and labels never prune.

evaluation.permutation_strategy: Freedman-Lane residual permutation around the ordinary change-point OOF prediction, independently within the four response-blind acceleration-by-environment sample cells, with the full candidate and baseline selection repeated
evaluation.baseline_baryonic_virial: frozen Sersic virial form with one training-fitted shared stellar mass scale
evaluation.baseline_structural: fixed ridge on mass size surface density shape color redshift and signal quality
evaluation.baseline_flexible: fixed quadratic and selected interaction ridge including structural spectral-clock and GEMA environment variables
evaluation.baseline_change_point: fixed ridge adding both-sided hinge functions at response-blind quantiles of acceleration density potential environment surface density and spectral clock
